title: Graph model
description: The typed node and edge vocabulary for the repository graph. A document may carry node_types, edge_types, or both — the kernel bindings split the committed vocabulary into node-types.json and edge-types.json. Activated by the phase 6-7 build decision (evaluation 2026-08-11-phase-6-7-build-decision-and-baseline); the reserved form remains valid so pre-activation documents still validate.

growth_trigger.description: The symptom that must be observed, and recorded as an evaluation, before this is built.

provenance_required.description: Fields every edge instance must carry, so a runtime-observed edge and a statically inferred edge can coexist without being confused for one another.
